interactions.description: 财务工作台拉取开票申请分页列表
interactions.securityEnforcement: Requires admin token and resolved shop_id multi-tenant isolation

interactions.description: 一键复制税号/抬头到剪贴板
interactions.clientVerification: navigator.clipboard.writeText with fallback textarea selection, toast notification on success

interactions.description: 财务弹窗确认开票并录入发票号
interactions.securityEnforcement: Requires valid invoice_id, updates status to ISSUED, records operator_id and issue_time

interactions.description: 财务弹窗驳回开票申请并填写原因
interactions.securityEnforcement: Non-empty reason required, status transitions to REJECTED, records operator_id

interactions.description: 顾客 H5 申请页面查看驳回原因并修改重提
interactions.securityEnforcement: Requires valid token, resets status to TITLE_SUBMITTED, clears error_msg

interactions.description: 状态过滤 Tab 切换与关键字过滤
interactions.clientVerification: switchTab updates active tab state and calls loadInvoices(1) with status parameter; search input bound to keyword query
